zh-CN.title: 链接气泡重新连成一体
items: VIP 标签与主题挂件会紧贴链接卡片
不同宽度的无图链接不再留下透明间隙
群聊 @ 成员候选列表始终显示在聊天背景上方

en.title: Link bubbles are whole again
items: VIP tags and themed ornaments now stay attached to link cards
Compact link previews no longer leave invisible layout gaps
The @ member picker stays above every chat background
